entries.title: Isaiah 64:1
segments: ¶Oh, that You would rend the heavens! That You would come down! That the mountains might shake at Your presence-

entries.title: Isaiah 64:2
segments: As fire burns brushwood, As fire causes water to boil-To make Your name known to Your adversaries, [That] the nations may tremble at Your presence!

entries.title: Isaiah 64:3
segments: When You did awesome things [for which] we did not look, You came down, The mountains shook at Your presence.

entries.title: Isaiah 64:4
segments: For since the beginning of the world [Men] have not heard nor perceived by the ear, Nor has the eye seen any God besides You, Who acts for the one who waits for Him.

entries.title: Isaiah 64:5
segments: You meet him who rejoices and does righteousness, [Who] remembers You in Your ways. You are indeed angry, for we have sinned-In these ways we continue; And we need to be saved.

entries.title: Isaiah 64:6
segments: ¶But we are all like an unclean [thing], And all our righteousnesses [are] like filthy rags; We all fade as a leaf, And our iniquities, like the wind, Have taken us away.

entries.title: Isaiah 64:7
segments: And [there is] no one who calls on Your name, Who stirs himself up to take hold of You; For You have hidden Your face from us, And have consumed us because of our iniquities.

entries.title: Isaiah 64:8
segments: But now, O LORD, You [are] our Father; We [are] the clay, and You our potter; And all we [are] the work of Your hand.

entries.title: Isaiah 64:9
segments: Do not be furious, O LORD, Nor remember iniquity forever; Indeed, please look-we all [are] Your people!

entries.title: Isaiah 64:10
segments: Your holy cities are a wilderness, Zion is a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation.

entries.title: Isaiah 64:11
segments: Our holy and beautiful temple, Where our fathers praised You, Is burned up with fire; And all our pleasant things are laid waste.

entries.title: Isaiah 64:12
segments: Will You restrain Yourself because of these [things], O LORD? Will You hold Your peace, and afflict us very severely?
